title: Add May 30 daily report tab
body:
## Summary

Adds a fifth tab "May 30 Report" to the GitHub Pages development reports site, covering the most productive day so far: **27 PRs merged** resolving **23 issues**.

Key themes for the day:
- **Collaborator Management** (5 PRs): revoke access, leave tree, prevent self-invite, management UI, role changes
- **Invitation System** (8 PRs): pending list, accept notifications, rate limiting, duplicate checks, cleanup, bulk invite, localized emails, confirmation step
- **Tree UX & Frontend** (8 PRs): ownership indicators, shared-with-you banner, unified tree selection, role gating, optimistic UI, error handling, tree deletion
- **Infrastructure** (5 PRs): Next.js 16 proxy migration, Docker/SWC fixes
- **Security** (1 PR): critical fail-open auth bypass fix in `proxy.ts`

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/9eedd1e7e0894657bd81ec3702d54bdc
Requested by: @yurizanini
